name: Zofia Lewandowska
bio:
Zofia Lewandowska brings a wealth of financial experience to Vee Masters, honed over two decades in corporate accounting and management. Her transition to motorsport stemmed from a lifelong passion ignited by her father, a former rally driver. She believes in meticulous planning, rigorous analysis, and transparent reporting to ensure the team's financial stability and strategic growth.

Zofia's pragmatic approach centers on optimizing resource allocation and maximizing return on investment. She’s known for her ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance. She is also adept at navigating the complex financial regulations of international motorsport, ensuring the team remains compliant and competitive.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, styled in soft waves with a side part.
physical.description: Zofia has a warm smile and a composed demeanor, often seen wearing smart business attire.

quirks: Always has a detailed spreadsheet for every possible scenario.
Keeps a small, antique abacus on her desk as a reminder of fundamental accounting principles.
Prefers to conduct meetings standing up to keep them concise and focused.
